name: io.github.funkyfunc/fearch
description: Respectful, corporate-safe, free web search and page reading for AI agents: honest identity, robots.txt, a human-in-the-loop browser tier, refusals as structured diagnoses, keyless official search.

packageArguments.name: --browser
packageArguments.description: auto | headless | headed | extension | off — auto (default): headless until a site shows a challenge, which then opens in a visible window for the person (their own Chrome via the bridge extension when connected; final where no display exists).

packageArguments.name: --robots
packageArguments.description: default | strict — robots.txt for the tool's own fetching.

packageArguments.name: --engines
packageArguments.description: Engine result pages in preference order: duckduckgo (default), google. Google needs a person on call to pass its checks.

packageArguments.name: --human-search
packageArguments.description: Google: each query is shown to the person in their MCP client, editable, and runs only when accepted.

packageArguments.name: --incognito
packageArguments.description: The person's own Chrome: open pages and result pages in an incognito window, not their profile.

packageArguments.name: --no-handoff
packageArguments.description: Never surface a bot check to the person; challenges are final.

packageArguments.name: --allow-domains
packageArguments.description: Comma-separated allow list of hosts (subdomains included).

packageArguments.name: --deny-domains
packageArguments.description: Comma-separated deny list of hosts (subdomains included).

packageArguments.name: --search
packageArguments.description: all | off — off disables the search tool.

packageArguments.name: --max-chars
packageArguments.description: Default character budget of a fetch result (12000).

packageArguments.name: --locale
packageArguments.description: BCP-47 tag engines and Accept-Language speak; defaults to the machine's locale.

packageArguments.name: --cache-dir
packageArguments.description: Where the cache, browser profile and pairing token live (~/.cache/fearch).

packageArguments.name: --audit-log
packageArguments.description: stderr | off | a file path — one JSON line per network request.

packageArguments.name: --ua-info-url
packageArguments.description: URL shown in the User-Agent (defaults to the project's bot-info page).

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional: higher GitHub API limits and code search.
